name: Yuuen no Alice
source:
"I was in a place I didn't recognize when I woke up. I had no memory and was confused about who I was, but then I met a mysterious boy with rabbit ears..."

[Translated from [url=https://nanaaprilfool8.wixsite.com/my-site/%E6%82%A0%E9%81%A0%E3%81%AE%E3%82%A2%E3%83%AA%E3%82%B9]official website[/url]]
translation:
“当我醒来时，我身处一个不认识的地方。我没有记忆，对自己是谁感到困惑，但后来我遇到了一个长着兔耳的神秘男孩……”

[翻译自[url=https://nanaaprilfool8.wixsite.com/my-site/%E6%82%A0%E9%81%A0%E3%81%AE%E3%82%A2%E3%83%AA%E3%82%B9]官网[/url]]
